BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. When learning Building Material Schedules, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Material Schedules.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Material Schedules.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Material Schedules.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Building Material Schedules.

3. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Information and Communication Technology

4. When learning Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.

5. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. CPU
   C. Speaker
   D. Monitor

6. When learning Wall Finishes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wall Finishes.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wall Finishes.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Wall Finishes.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wall Finishes.

7. When learning Introduction to Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Building Drawing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Drawing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Building Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Building Drawing.

8. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

9. When learning Building Construction Project Phase 11, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Construction Project Phase 11.

10. When learning Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Drawing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Drawing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Drawing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Building Drawing.

11. When learning Fixings and Fittings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Fixings and Fittings.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fixings and Fittings.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fixings and Fittings.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fixings and Fittings.

12. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Pre-cast Concrete Products and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Building Material Schedules and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Waste Water Disposal and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Maintenance of Plumbing Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

2. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Material Schedules.

3. D — Information and Communication Technology

4. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.

5. B — CPU

6. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wall Finishes.

7. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Drawing.

8. D — Never touch live wires with wet hands

9. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Construction Project Phase 11.

10. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Drawing.

11. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fixings and Fittings.

12. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Pre-cast Concrete Products; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
